comparators.autonomous: the fixed checkpoint receives only its own preceding state
comparators.teacher_forced_ceiling: the identical fixed checkpoint receives the true preceding residual at layers 3:15

data.host_patch_rule: within ranks 0:199, replace every old-source row with max(final_layer_mse,max_layer_mse)>5e-7 by its corrected near-floor-min trajectory

decision_gates.fatal_finite: the complete autonomous validation rollout must be finite
decision_gates.primary_success: autonomous validation final MSE <3.44e-8 (10% below the established 3.82e-8 family)
decision_gates.stretch: record whether autonomous validation final MSE <1e-8

evaluation.checkpoint: fixed epoch 16; no validation checkpoint selection
evaluation.metrics_opening: score ranks 160:199 once after training finishes

hypothesis: training the exact physical recurrence under progressively self-generated state exposure will reduce autonomous state-distribution shift enough to beat 3.44e-8 while retaining a teacher-forced ceiling near 1e-8
no_retuning: stop after this one registered architecture and schedule regardless of validation outcome

training.loss: normalized all-corrected-layer rollout MSE + equal final-layer focus + 1e-3 near-one transport-gain penalty
